get.description: Section is cohorts, snapshots, cohorts-by-country, snapshots-by-country, monthly or data-status. Dates are yyyy-MM-dd and widen to whole weeks; country is an ISO alpha-2 code or ZZ for unknown, and omitted means all. Not ready and Unavailable figures have null numbers, never 0. Combined rows cover only the Value weeks, see weeksIncluded and weeksInRange. cutoff is the boundary date; to is the last complete day. Snapshot figures are judged over their whole window; weekly figures appear on Sundays only, and days-active values carry their group's total and share (C33–C41). data-status.payments describes the RevenueCat payment record, all-time; its country agreement compares the signup country with RevenueCat's last-seen location (C53–C57). Every Unavailable value carries unavailableReason: NOT_RECORDED_AT_LAUNCH (the week began before paid memberships launched), BEFORE_DATA_START or RECORDING_GAP (C67, C89). Every Not ready cohort value carries readyOn, the Luxembourg date of the first night whose run shows its number; a Not ready combined row, including every cohorts-by-country row, carries its earliest week's. Snapshots and monthly carry none (C109). Every value carries dataFrom, source (MONNETT or REVENUECAT) and definitionChanges, empty when none falls inside the range (C87, C88, C90). cohorts-by-country and snapshots-by-country return one row per country plus ZZ and a total equal to the unfiltered read: snapshots for the range's last day with wauShare and payingMembersShare, cohorts as the range row per country. availableCountries lists every country with stored figures. They refuse a country (C91). paying_members stores member and member_plus by monthly and annual plan; member, member_plus and total are served as their sums, so they always add up (C72–C80). registered stores members by country source (source:phone_region, source:profile, source:none); total is served as their sum, so the sources always add up (C81–C86). monthly widens dates to whole Luxembourg months (default 12, at most 36), refuses a country, and serves month_end_paying (members and gross MRR), month_end_proceeds, unpriced_payments, still_paying (cohorts by first-payment month; new_payers; checkpoints mK and yK), payment_movements and store_fees. Amounts are USD, annual plans one twelfth, each rounded half up to cents once. A month is final, stored once and never changed, the settle days after it ends; until then the running month and a month in its settle days are PROVISIONAL, recalculated every night to date. One state covers the whole month (C92–C104). Full conventions: docs/analytics/figure-conventions.md.

post.summary: Sync address-book phone numbers and get the mutual matches
post.description: Takes E.164 phone numbers from the address book and returns the visible accounts that verified one of them and have the caller's number in their own synced contacts. The numbers are keyed with a server secret for the lookup and not stored; "caller has account" links are, as account ids. A call never changes whether the caller is findable, and replaces the caller's previous links unless `append` is true. Every call is one sync of at most 10,000 numbers (configurable): 3 manual syncs per account per day (1 in the account's first 7 days) plus 1 with `trigger: "background"` and 1 with `trigger: "reenable"` (the sync right after the user switches finding people from contacts back on, so a new account that spent its manual sync in onboarding can still turn it back on). A caller who is not findable gets CONTACT_DISCOVERY_OFF, and a server without the number key secret CONTACT_MATCHES_FAILED; neither spends a sync. A call with `append` false and no valid E.164 number gets CONTACT_NO_USABLE_NUMBERS, keeps the previous links and spends no sync; it aborts the sync, so the client sends none of its further chunks.

429.description: Too many syncs of this kind today for this user

get.summary: Get discover feed of public posts from non-followed accounts
get.description: Serves two feeds from one endpoint; startScope or lat+lng+radius is required, a request with neither answers 400. Area feed (startScope=CITY|COUNTRY|GLOBAL, cursor-paginated, response shape {items, next_cursor}): CITY matches city+country together, COUNTRY matches country, GLOBAL matches everything and honours includeUnlocated (ignored at CITY/COUNTRY). Nearby feed (lat+lng+radius all present, cursor-paginated, response shape {items, next_cursor}): returns posts ring by ring outward from the anchor point, nearest first, boundaries taken from backend configuration, ending at the outermost ring without continuing into city, country or global posts; includeUnlocated has no effect on it, since a post with no coordinates can never be inside a circle; a nearby request takes precedence when a start area is also sent. Like the area feed, it emits a widening announcement item when it crosses a ring boundary. Seen posts are permanently excluded on every feed; this endpoint does NOT mark posts as seen.

parameters.description: Username prefix to match — prefix-only here, not substring. Below the configured minimum length the result is MIN_CHARACTERS_NOT_REACHED.
parameters.name: search

200.description: Mentionable users matching the username prefix

get.summary: List users the requester may tag, optionally matching a search term
get.description: Returns users the requester is allowed to tag in a post, so the picker searches the whole eligible set instead of filtering the pages it has already loaded. The term matches username or display name anywhere in the value, ignoring case. Omitting it browses the unfiltered list; unlike the mention endpoint there is no minimum length.

parameters.description: Term matched anywhere in username or display name. Optional — omitting it returns the unfiltered list.
parameters.name: search

200.description: Taggable users, optionally narrowed by the search term

get.summary: List the users related to an account, optionally matching a search term
get.description: Returns one page of the users related to the account, so a people list searches the whole relation instead of filtering the pages it has already loaded. The term matches username or display name anywhere in the value, ignoring case; omitting it browses the unfiltered list, with no minimum length. A private account is refused for every filter unless the requester is that account or an approved follower.

parameters.description: Public UUID of the account whose relations are listed
parameters.name: publicId

parameters.description: Which relation to list: followers, following, friends or mutual
parameters.name: filter

parameters.description: Term matched anywhere in username or display name. Optional — omitting it returns the unfiltered list.
parameters.name: search

200.description: Related users, optionally narrowed by the search term. Business refusals also arrive here, not as an error status: a private account the requester may not see and an unknown publicId both return success=false with a code, so branch on the envelope rather than on the HTTP status.

delete.description: Ensures the current user does not block the target. Safe to retry: unblocking a non-blocked user is a no-op. Does not auto-restore any prior follow relationship. Returns the SuCoMe envelope with payload { blocked }.

200.description: SuCoMe envelope with the current block state.

post.description: Ensures the current user blocks the target. Safe to retry: the block cascade and audit entry run only on a real transition. Returns the SuCoMe envelope with payload { blocked }.

200.description: SuCoMe envelope with the current block state. CANNOT_BLOCK_SELF / TO_USER_NOT_FOUND are returned with success=false.

delete.description: Ensures the current user does not follow the target, removing an active follow or withdrawing a pending request. Safe to retry: unfollowing a non-followed user is a no-op. Returns the SuCoMe envelope with payload { following, followerCount, followingCount }.

200.description: SuCoMe envelope with the current follow state.

post.description: Ensures the current user follows the target (or has a pending request for a private account). Safe to retry: side effects fire only on a real transition. Returns the SuCoMe envelope with payload { following, followerCount, followingCount }.

200.description: SuCoMe envelope with the current follow state. Business failures (CANNOT_FOLLOW_SELF, USER_BLOCKED, BLOCKED_BY_USER, TO_USER_NOT_FOUND) use success=false. FOLLOW_LIMIT_REACHED carries the plan's limit details in the payload. FOLLOWERS_LIMIT_REACHED names only the limit type.

get.description: Returns the target user's active stories (last 24 hours), grouped as that user's story ring. Usable for the caller's own stories and for viewing another user's stories.

200.description: SuCoMe envelope with the user's story group. Business failures (AUTHOR_NOT_FOUND) use success=false.

get.summary: Get months containing stories for a user
get.description: Returns the distinct months (YYYY-MM) with visible stories for the user's profile archive.

200.description: SuCoMe envelope with list of months

get.summary: Get user's stories for a specific month
get.description: Returns stories for the user in the specified month (YYYY-MM) for profile month sections.

200.description: SuCoMe envelope with list of story items

400.description: Month is not in YYYY-MM format

get.description: The badge the Synapse module stamps into the user's member events; null when none.

200.description: SuCoMe envelope; payload carries the lowercase badge or null.

get.summary: Resolve an invite code to its owner
get.description: Case-insensitive; Crockford aliases and separators are accepted. Unknown and malformed codes both fail with REFERRAL_CODE_NOT_FOUND. Rate-limited globally.

200.description: SuCoMe envelope; payload contains the code and the inviter's share user DTO.

get.description: Returns the comment's publicId and the author's share-user fields. The card itself renders the author.

200.description: SuCoMe envelope; payload contains the share comment DTO on success.

get.description: Returns the post's publicId and the author's share-user fields. The card itself renders the author.

200.description: SuCoMe envelope; payload contains the share post DTO on success.

get.summary: Resolve an invite code to its owner for the share invite page
get.description: Case-insensitive; Crockford aliases and separators are accepted. Unknown and malformed codes both fail with REFERRAL_CODE_NOT_FOUND. Not rate-limited: every share-page visitor arrives from the share server.

200.description: SuCoMe envelope; payload contains the code and the inviter's share user DTO.

get.summary: Resolve a username to a share-card user payload
get.description: Case-insensitive username lookup. Returns the minimal user fields needed to render the share fallback card.

200.description: SuCoMe envelope; payload contains the share user DTO on success.

400.description: Malformed payload or missing event field

500.description: Persistence or unexpected processing failure, or the payment record failed to write; RevenueCat should retry

post.summary: Receive an inbound SMS for phone verification
